articles.title: Bengaluru nurse chased, attacked with machete by husband; acid thrown

Investigations are ongoing into the couple's separation due to differences.

articles.title: America's Rorshach Test: Why Sydney Sweeney makes liberals go mad
articles.summary: That Sydney’s body had taken on deeper meaning beyond its corporeal form and become a political battleground was evident in 2022 when she threw her mother a 60th birthday party where one guest wore a Blue Lives Matter T-shirt and others wore red caps that said “Make Sixty Great Again”. That was enough for Sweeney to be cast out of the proverbial liberal heaven by some imaginary association with the Orange One.

articles.title: Accused was returning from club, cousin instigated him to chase woman biker
articles.summary: Two men were arrested for allegedly chasing and ramming a woman biker in Gurgaon. The accused were returning from a club when the incident occurred on Sunday. Police have described the event as a murder bid and formed a special investigation team. Investigators are recreating the alleged chase and examining footage from the incident. The two accused remain in police custody until Friday for further investigation.

articles.title: New Green Card rules from September 18: Full list of categories affected
articles.summary: Effective September 18, the USCIS will enforce new public charge regulations for Green Card applicants. These updated guidelines impose stricter financial evaluations and recognize a broader range of public benefits. This modification impacts family and employment-based Green Card submissions lodged from that date forward. Any applications submitted before September 18, 2026, will adhere to the previous criteria, while some applicant groups will still be exempt from these changes.

articles.title: Doctors away, driver 'takes over charge' in Kanpur hospital's OPD
articles.summary: A driver allegedly prescribed medicines to patients at a Kanpur government hospital. This incident occurred while the emergency medical officer was attending a court hearing. Hospital authorities have sought an explanation from the doctor regarding the driver's actions. The doctor acknowledged his driver wrote prescriptions and stated he removed him for acting independently. Action will be taken if the doctor fails to provide a satisfactory explanation.

articles.title: Rizwan loses Lahore HC plea; PCB to take actions on Pakistan cricketers
articles.summary: The Pakistan Cricket Board will wait for the NCCIA’s forensic report before deciding whether to take disciplinary action against Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq. The Lahore High Court dismissed Rizwan’s petition challenging NCCIA notices. The agency is examining mobile phones taken from both players and is expected to submit its findings to the PCB next week.

Colorado spends nearly $2m on 2,100-acre ranch to help prairie chickens recover

The Southern Plains Land Trust has acquired nearly 2,100 acres for just under $2 million to restore grassland habitat. The property, near an active breeding site, will be restored with Colorado Parks and Wildlife to support the species’ recovery.

Video: US forces take out floating refuelling station allegedly tied to drug trade

This vessel allegedly supported illicit drug trafficking operations for Ecuador's Los Choneros organization. US forces removed the crew and transferred them to Ecuadorian authorities after clearing the vessel. The refuelling station was then sunk by US forces following the operation. Neill’s own journey in acting stemmed from keen observation and hands-on experiences, a philosophy that resonates with aspiring professionals today.

articles.title: Man loses job weeks before becoming a father, finds an unexpected gift in it

He now embraces this appreciation as he prepares for his next professional chapter.
